description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator, which performs validation routines on configuration schema interchange objects within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for validating directives, IDs, allowed values, value aliases, and directive aliases, utilizing an internal parser and maintaining context for error reporting.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating the structure and contents of configuration interchange objects within HTMLPurifier, ensuring correctness of directives, IDs, allowed values, and aliases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance, including creating a new parser object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of a fully-formed interchange object, iterating over directives and verifying consistency.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validates a specific interchange ID object, ensuring it is of the correct type and properly formatted.

methods.name: validateDirective
methods.description: Validates a single directive object, checking its ID, description, type, default value, allowed values, and aliases.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAllowed
methods.description: Validates the allowed values for a directive, ensuring they are permitted and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateDirectiveValueAliases
methods.description: Validates value aliases for directives, ensuring they are strings, valid, and do not conflict with allowed values.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAliases
methods.description: Validates directive aliases, ensuring no collision with existing directives or aliases.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a validator atom for a specific member of an object, aiding in validation routines.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws a validation exception with contextual information.

methods.name: getFormattedContext
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the current validation context.
